description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of Technical Education and Training
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-01-26, to appoint Mrs. Dilki Wathsala Marambage, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to the post of Director General of the Department of Technical Education and Training on full-time acting basis. She has been promoted to the Special Grade of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service by the Public Service Commission, from 2026-01-01. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education, and Vocational Education to appoint Mrs. Dilki Wathsala Marambage to the post of Director General of the Department of Technical Education and Training on permanent basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Co-operative Employees Commission Act, No.12 of 1972
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The need to amend the Co-operative Employees Commission Act No. 12 of 1972 has been identified, taking into account the need to align the functioning of co-operative societies with the current socio-economic conditions and changes in the general law. The Co-operative Employees Commission has prepared an initial draft containing proposed amendments, based on the views and proposals of co-operative societies, members of their boards of directors, co-operative employees, and other interested parties, as well as on the experience gained by the Commission. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security, and Co-operative Development to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the Co-operative Employees Commission Act No.12 of 1972, based on the said initial draft, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Public Assets Management Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-07-22, to publish the Public Assets Management Bill in the Government Gazette and subsequently submit it to Parliament for approval. However, the Bill could not be passed in Parliament due to its dissolution in October 2024. Subsequently, a Committee comprising of Officials and experts in the relevant field was appointed to further review the Bill. The said Committee has identified necessary amendments to be made to the Bill and prepared a preliminary draft incorporating the proposed changes. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to suspend further action regarding the Public Assets Management Bill published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2024-08-02, and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a bill based on the initial draft formulated by the Committee of Experts in the relevant field, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Integrated One Health Pandemic Preparedness and Response Strengthening Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has achieved remarkable progress in controlling communicable diseases and delivering maternal and child healthcare services. Furthermore, the country has made significant strides in the prevention and control of vaccine-preventable diseases, maintaining a vaccination coverage rate exceeding 95%. Sri Lanka has signed an Agreement on 2025-03-20 to secure a grant from the Pandemic Fund, a collaborative partnership involving donor nations, co-investors, foundations, and civil organizations. Under the terms of the said Agreement, all activities related to the grant must be fully implemented and concluded by 2028-03-31. Sri Lanka's response to the COVID-19 pandemic and other public health emergencies due to zoonotic diseases has revealed deficiencies and gaps in the national response across both the human and animal health sectors. Activities proposed to address these gaps are set to be implemented through the Pandemic Fund, and an action plan covering the 2026-2028 period has also been formulated in collaboration with funding organizations. The said plan also includes key infrastructure development activities, such as the establishment of the Sri Lanka Center for Disease Control and Prevention and the upgrading of physical infrastructure at the National Public Health Reference Laboratory of the Medical Research Institute. Funding for the establishment of the Center for Disease Control and Prevention is expected to be provided by the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement 35 identified activities including the upgrading of the physical infrastructure at the National Public Health Reference Laboratory of the Medical Research Institute, utilizing the total provisions of Rs.5,431 million, comprising a grant of Rs.4,785 million obtained under the Health Pandemic and Response Strengthening Project and a contribution of Rs.646 million from the Government of Sri Lanka.

description: Awarding the contract for widening and improvement of the Kandy - Jaffna Road (A0009) (CH 58+240km to CH 63+000 km)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Under the Widening and Improvement Programme of National Highways, bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure for widening and improvement of the section of the Kandy-Jaffna Road spanning from CH 58+240km to CH 63+000 km. Eight (08) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendations made by the High Level Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board following the evaluation of the said bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to award the said contract to M/s Tudawe Brothers (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of Rs.1.070 billion (inclusive of contingency funds and exclusive of Value Added Tax), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Financial Assistance from the Asian Development Bank for the implementation of the ‘Skills Development System Transformation Programme’
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-08-24, to authorize the Department of External Resources to conduct negotiations with the Asian Development Bank to secure financial assistance for the implementation of the 'Skills Development Systems Transformation Programme.' Accordingly, the Department of External Resources has taken necessary steps to hold formal loan negotiations with the Asian Development Bank on 2026-08-25, to obtain a facility worth US$ 100 million in support of the sectorial strategic plan aimed at developing an effective technical and vocational education and training system. The proposed loan facility comprises US$ 50 million from Concessional Ordinary Capital Resources and US$ 50 million from Regular Ordinary Capital Resources under the Results‑based Financing Modality. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning, and Economic Development, to obtain a Results-based Financing Facility of US$ 100 million from the Asian Development Bank for the implementation of the 'Skills Development Systems Transformation Programme’, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a Grant Assistance from the Government of Japan to improve the Pump Station on the Kelani River Basin
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan has agreed to provide a grant aid of 2.179 billion Japanese Yen (approximately 4.56 billion Sri Lankan Rupees) to implement the project for upgrading the pumping station in the Kelani River basin. The proposed project for the Improvement of the Pump Station aims to mitigate flood risks in the Mudun Ela sub-basin covering Wattala and Peliyagoda areas, facilitate sustainable urban development, and create developable land for national economic activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning, and Economic Development, to sign the Exchange of Note with the Government of Japan and the Grant Agreement with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) to secure the proposed grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for the supply of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) for Litro Gas Lanka Limited for the year 2027
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the International Competitive Bidding Procedure to procure 420,000 (±20%) MT of LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) for Litro Gas Lanka Limited. Four (04) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation made by the High Level Procurement Committee, following the evaluation of the said bids,  the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to award the contract for the supply of 420,000 MT (±20%) of LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) (with a guaranteed minimum quantity of 336,000 MT) for a period of 12 months commencing from  2027-01-01, to M/s OQ Trading Limited, the substantially responsive lowest bidder at a total value comprising the Saudi Aramco contract price + US$ 133.93 per MT (on Cost, Insurance and Freight basis), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of the stationery allowance to the school children for the school year 2027
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The School Stationery Allowance Programme has been in operation since 2025. Accordingly, the Cabinet was informed by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning, and Economic Development that steps are being taken to directly transfer the School Stationery Allowance of Rs.6,000 to the bank accounts of 1,000,000 students from families enrolled in the 'Aswesuma' programme for the year 2027, and to provide vouchers worth Rs.6,000 to 500,000 children identified by the Ministry of Education, Higher Education, and Vocational Education under the same programme and the Cabinet granted its concurrence for the same.

description: Securing additional provisions under the Re-energizing of the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Loan Scheme (Re-MSME Plus)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Re-energizing of the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Loan Scheme (Re-MSME Plus) Loan Scheme was implemented in this year by consolidating the Re-MSME Loan Scheme with several selected ongoing loan programmes. Approvals have been granted to implement projects relating to the value of Rs.4,276.50 million to uplift businesses affected by the 'Ditwah' disaster situation and projects relating to the value of Rs.25,926.84 million for other micro, small and medium-scale enterprises, at the end of August 2026. Provisions amounting to Rs.30,000 million had been provided for the Re‑MSME Plus Loan Scheme and the entire amount has been utilized by participating financial institutions by now. Participating financial institutions have reported a requirement for additional provisions of approximately Rs.7,500 million for projects that have completed the internal appraisal process and obtained loan approvals, and are ready for loan disbursement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to provide additional provisions of Rs.7,500 million, enabling to continue to grant loans under the said loan scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Student Hostel, Workshops and Cafeteria for the University of Vocational Technology, Ratmalana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2017-01-03, to implement the Project for constructing a student hostel with accommodation facilities for 600 students, modern teaching workshops, and a canteen with a seating capacity of 300 for the University of Vocational Technology in Ratmalana. Nevertheless, implementation of the project was delayed due to changes in planning and procurement activities, the economic crisis and various other factors and subsequently, steps were taken to temporarily suspend the Project in 2022 in line with the Government policy of restricting capital expenditure. A problematic situation has arisen by now with regard to the fulfillment of students' welfare and educational needs due to the inadequacy of hostel, workshops and canteen facilities of the University. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to resume and implement the said Project within the premises of the University of Vocational Technology in Ratmalana, under a revised total cost estimate of Rs. 3,380 million within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework of 2027-2029, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strategic Diversification of the State Printing Corporation through a Public Private Partnership
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The State Printing Corporation, which was established in the year 1968, functions as the primary state entity for printing school textbooks, official government publications, and documents of Government institutions. Although the Corporation has consistently recorded financial profits in recent years, challenges regarding production efficiency and cost competitiveness have arisen due to the deterioration of machinery and outdated printing technology. Accordingly, restructuring its business model and technical capabilities has become essential to ensure the long-term sustainability of the Corporation. Taking into account these matters, the feasibility of implementing a strategic diversification programme titled 'Smart Print Initiative' has been identified, aiming to transform the State Printing Corporation into a high-security printing entity driven by modern technology. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to implement the proposed Diversification Programme under a Public-Private Partnership framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Co-Financing Scheme for Commercialization of Research and Development Innovations with High Commercialization Potential and Large – Scale Capital Requirements
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Measures are being taken by the National Initiative for Research and Development Commercialization (NIRDC), to provide grants and concessionary loan facilities for the effective commercialization of research and development innovations in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, under Project Category 01, a full grant up to Rs.10 million is provided for the commercialization of Research and Development Projects with high commercialization potential and small-scale capital requirements. Under Project Category 02, a grant of Rs.10 million together with a concessionary loan of up to Rs.40 million at a concessionary interest rate of 3% is provided through banks for the commercialization of Research and Development Projects requiring medium-scale capital. In addition, the suitability of implementing a co-financing scheme of up to Rs.500 million has been identified to be implemented as Project Category 03 for the commercialization of Research and Development Projects with high commercialization potential and require large-scale capital. Under the proposed financing scheme, plans are in place to provide loans of up to Rs.450 million through commercial banks with an interest subsidy of 5% to cover additional capital requirements, in addition to the above the Rs. 10 million grant and the loan of up to Rs.40 million at a concessionary interest rate of 3%. Accordingly, the proposal made by the President to implement the proposed Financing Scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of the Nakolagane Sanctuary under the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Several Private Companies had utilized approximately 1,500 acres of land, which had remained as forests for some time, located in the Galgamuwa Divisional Secretariat Division of the Kurunegala District, for activities such as cash crop cultivation, mineral mining and soil excavation. Several environmental organizations have filed a petition in the Supreme Court seeking to halt to these activities, citing the environmental damage caused by the deforestation and the exacerbation of the human-elephant conflict in the North Western Province. Delivering its Judgment on the petition, the Supreme Court ordered that the entire area comprising of the 55 hectares of cleared land as well as the remaining forest sections be declared either a sanctuary or an elephant management reserve under section 2(2) of the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance. In accordance with the said Order, through a joint survey conducted by the Department of Survey and the Department of Wildlife Conservation, a land area of ​​682 hectares has been identified to be declared a wildlife sanctuary. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to declare the said land area to the extent of 682 hectare area including the maximum water level of the nearby Palukadawala Tank, as the Nakolagane Sanctuary, as per the provisions of the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance and with the concurrence of the Department of Irrigation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting the Roads not belonging to the Road Development Authority to the said Authority and formulating a proper mechanism for their maintenance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into account proposals submitted by District Coordinating Committees, approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-07-20, to appoint a Committee chaired by an Additional Secretary of the Ministry of Transport, Highways and Urban Development for making recommendations with regard to transferring roads currently maintained by Provincial Councils or Local Authorities but not belonging to the Road Development Authority, to the Road Development Authority, as well as securing the necessary funds and staff for their maintenance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to take further steps to declare roads currently under the authority of other institutions as National Highways, based on recommendations from Road Acquisition Committee of the Road Development Authority, following an assessment of basic eligibility, technical feasibility, and relevant criteria with regard to requests made to upgrade said roads, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing financial facilities for the Water Supply and Sanitation Reform Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-03-16, to obtain a Policy Based Lending of US$ 620 million from the Asian Development Bank under 05 Sub‑programmes to continue Sri Lanka’s reform agenda in parallel with Extended Fund Facility programme of the International Monetary Fund. It has been planned to implement the Water Supply and Sanitation Reform Programme - Sub‑programme 2 utilizing US$ 100 million of the said loan amount.  The programme aims to assist the Government of Sri Lanka in addressing the challenges such as weak water resource management, operational and financial inefficiencies, exposure to climate risks, social inclusion gaps and fragmented stakeholder coordination through comprehensive reform measures. Accordingly, the proposal made by the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to enter into an Agreement with the Asian Development Bank to obtain the said Policy Based Lending facility, comprising US$ 50 million from the regular ordinary capital resources of the Bank and US$ 50 million from its Concessional Ordinary Capital Resources, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between the Asia‑Pacific Accreditation and Certification Commission and the Tertiary and Vocational Education Commission of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was previously signed between the Asia-Pacific Accreditation and Certification Commission based in the Philippines and the Tertiary and Vocational Education Commission of Sri Lanka, with the aim of strengthening accreditation practices within the Technical and Vocational Education and Training System of Sri Lanka. As the validity period of the said MoU, which was signed for a period of 05 years has now expired, a proposal has been made to sign a new MoU in that regard. The proposed Memorandum of Understanding aims to achieve several objectives: strengthening regional ties and cooperation in vocational education, securing support from the Asia Pacific Accreditation and Certification Commission (APACC) for the advancement of vocational education in Sri Lanka, promoting APACC accreditation and certification of vocational training institutions, further strengthening the National Vocational Qualification Framework of Sri Lanka, appointing a National Accreditation Coordinator for Sri Lanka and identifying potential local accreditation personnel who could be trained in APACC procedures and standards for future accreditation activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, for both parties to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to act in the Post of Director General of the Department of National Botanic Gardens on full time basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Ms. H.C.P. Jayaweera, who served as the Director General of the Department of National Botanic Gardens, retired from the public service upon reaching the age of 60 on 2026-09-14. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to appoint Mr. M.M.D.J. Senarathna, the senior most Officer in Grade I of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service currently serving in the said Department to act in the vacant post of Director General of the Department of National Botanic Gardens on a full-time basis, with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introducing the Fauna and Flora (Regulating Activities of Adi Wasi Communities within Designated Areas) Regulations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Aiming to safeguard the traditional livelihoods and ecosystems of indigenous communities, the need has been identified to introduce a formal regulatory mechanism that ensures their engagement in livelihood activities by being more sensitive to existing laws. Accordingly, Fauna and Flora (Regulating Activities of Adi Wasi Communities within Designated Areas) Regulations have been drafted under the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance (Chapter 469) for permitting any registered member of the indigenous community to engage in designated activities within the relevant areas in order to protect the rights acquired through law, custom, usage, or traditional practice that are fundamental to the survival of indigenous people and are exercised on a state land. The proposal made by the Minister of Environment to publish the said Regulations in the Government Gazette and subsequently present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulation of an Institutional Framework for the establishment of the Upper Watershed Area Management Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Policy approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2026-06-08 to establish the Upper Watershed Area Management Authority to identify and implement a systematic, long-term programme to protect the central highlands including upper watershed areas ensuring resilience against adverse climatic impacts caused by natural disasters and human activities, while also facilitating the country's sustainable development. Accordingly, a concept paper outlining the proposed institutional structure, duties, powers, and functional scope, and governance and coordination mechanisms has been prepared by the Technical Expert Committee appointed by the Secretary to the President. Based on the said concept paper, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a bill containing the necessary legal provisions for the establishment of the Upper Watershed Area Management Authority.

description: Supply and laying of HDPE distribution pipelines, providing service connections and construction of 250 cubic meters capacity water tower for Community Based Organizations of the Medawachchiya and Rambewa Divisional Secretariat Divisions of the Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project- Phase II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Under the Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project-Phase II implemented with the financial assistance of the Japan International Cooperation Agency, the National Water Supply and Drainage Board has planned to provide safe drinking water to the residents of Medawachchiya and Rambewa by constructing an elevated water tower with a capacity of 250 cubic meters and laying a 425-kilometer pipeline network to serve 17,000 water connections. For the purpose, bids have been invited in 2022 by following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure, with the concurrence of the Japan International Cooperation Agency, to select a suitable contractor. However, the procurement process could not proceed due to the economic crisis prevailed in the country. Considering the time required to re-invite bids, the JICA has proposed proceeding with the procurement using the bids already submitted and applying price adjustments in accordance with relevant regulations. Accordingly, based on the recommendations made by the High-Level Procurement Committee following the evaluation of bids submitted by three bidders who had agreed to extend the validity period of their bid securities, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to award the said contract to M/s Sierra Construction Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of 600.11 million Japanese Yen and 1.76 billion Sri Lankan Rupees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding Special Project status for the Kerawalapitiya - Colombo Port Second Underground Cable Project under the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2021-09-13 to implement the second 220kV underground cable project extending from Kerawalapitiya to the Colombo Port, in accordance with the Long-Term Transmission Plan of the country under funding from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank. Accordingly, the contract for the implementation of the said project was awarded by the then Ceylon Electricity Board to the selected contractor, the consortium comprising M/s Jiangsu ETERN Co. Ltd. (China) and LS Cable & System Limited (LS Cable Korea), following the formal procurement procedure. As of now, the project has been transferred to National Transmission Network Service Provider (Private) Limited, a successor company to the Ceylon Electricity Board. Recognizing the strategic importance of the project, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to designate the second 220kV underground cable project from Kerawalapitiya to the Colombo Port as a Special Project under the provisions of the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002, in order to secure the necessary exemptions from the payment of Value Added Tax, customs import duties, and other relevant taxes, levies, and charges.

description: Awarding of the Contract for the extension of the existing Quay Wall and the Construction of the Access Road and Boundary Wall at the Valaichchenai Fishery Harbour, and its Construction Supervision Consultancy Services Contract
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-08-04 to implement the project for extending the existing quay wall and constructing the access road and boundary wall at the Valaichchenai Fishery Harbour. Bids were invited following the formal procurement guidelines to select a contractor to carry out construction activities of the project, and two (02) bids have been received for the same. Following the evaluation of said bids, the Procurement Committee of the Ministry has recommended to award the contract to M/s Senok Trade Combine (Pvt) Limited, the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of Rs.766.88 million (excluding Value Added Tax). Bids have also been invited to select a consultancy firm for the construction supervision consultancy services of the project by following the formal procurement guidelines, and three (03) bids have been received for the same. Following the evaluation of the said bids, the Ministerial Consultants Procurement Committee recommended awarding the consultancy services contract to M/s EML Consultant PLC, the substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of Rs.35.54 million (excluding Value Added Tax). Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources to award the said contracts, based on the recommendations of the Ministerial Procurement Committee and the Ministerial Consultants Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Deployment of a new vessel for the Delft-Jaffna Sea Route under the ‘Praja Shakthi’ National Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to the inadequacy of facilities for the transportation of a large number of passengers safely on a single trip in the Jaffna Peninsula, particularly between the mainland and outlying islands like Delft, maintaining passenger marine transportation has become challenging. As a solution, the appropriateness of deploying a sea ferry capable of carrying approximately 150 passengers on the Delft-Jaffna Sea Route under the 'Praja Shakthi' National Programme has been identified. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Marine Resources to have the ferry manufactured by Cey-Nor Foundation Ltd., to operate the vessel through the Delft Development Society (established under the Department of Samurdhi Development), and to utilize the generated revenue for the livelihood development of all low-income residents in the Delft area, including the society's members.

description: Carrying out a feasibility study to minimize the traffic congestion at the Lotus Intersection, Port Access Elevated Highway and Marine Drive Connectivity and surrounding areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Road Development Authority has called for Expressions of Interest to select a Consultancy Agency to carry out a feasibility study aimed at alleviating traffic congestion at the Lotus Intersection, Port Access Elevated Highway and Marine Drive Connectivity and surrounding areas. Following the shortlisting of the submitted Expressions of Interest for the same, Requests for Proposals were issued to 05 entities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development based on the recommendation submitted by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee on the said proposals, to award the said Consultancy Contract to M/s Master Hellie's Engineering Consultants (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.91.21 million (excluding VAT) comprising a Local Component of Rs.52.44 million (excluding VAT) and a Foreign Component of US$ 122,859, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Road Infrastructure Improvement Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Road Development Authority has called for bids following the national competitive bidding procedure to select contractors for the implementation of several road infrastructure improvement projects. description: Granting Financial Subsidy for farmers cultivating Paddy lands for the Maha Season 2026/27
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to continue to implement the fertilizer subsidy programme for securing fertilizer required for paddy cultivated in fields as well as for other field crops determined at Seasonal meetings and those recommended by the Director General of Agriculture, during the 2026/27 Maha season as well. The cost of providing the financial subsidy for fertilizer for the said Season is estimated as Rs.16 billion. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to pay the financial fertilizer subsidy of Rs.30,000 per hectare up to a maximum of two hectares for paddy and other field crops cultivated in paddy fields during the 2026/27 Maha Season, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the construction of Internal Wastewater Collection Network and Pumping System for the Textile Manufacturing Zone at Punnaikuda, Eravurpattu, Batticaloa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2020-11-02, for the development of infrastructure at the Textile Manufacturing Zone located in the Punnaikuda area of ​​the Eravurpattu Divisional Secretariat Division in the Batticaloa District. Accordingly, bids have been invited following the national competitive bidding procedure to select a contractor for the construction of the Internal Wastewater Collection Network and Pumping System within the said Zone. Seven bids have been submitted for the same. The proposal made by the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning, and Economic Development to award the said contract to the substantially responsive lowest bidder, CGC-KDESH JV (China Geo Engineering Corporation & K D Ebert and Sons Holdings (Pvt) Ltd. JV), for a sum of Rs.511.78 million (excluding Value Added Tax) based on the recommendations submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for printing School Textbooks/Modules required for the year 2027
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Educational Publications has called for bids following the national competitive procurement method to select printing firms for printing 421 types of school textbooks/modules including those for Grades 1, 2 and 6 required for free distribution to schoolchildren in the year 2027. A total of 31 bids have been submitted for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to award the contracts for printing the relevant 421 types of textbooks/modules to 21 printing firms for a total sum of Rs.1,614.69 million (excluding Value Added Tax), based on recommendations made by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into an Agreement between Sri Lanka and Thailand on Visa Exemption for Holders of Ordinary Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka and Thailand have agreed to enter into an Agreement on Visa-Exemption for Holders of Ordinary Passports, with a view to further strengthening friendly relations between both countries and facilitating travel for their citizens. Under this Agreement, citizens of both countries holding valid ordinary passports will be permitted to enter, exit, and transit without a prior visa for general tourism purposes excluding employment, education, media work, or activities requiring prior approval, for a single visit of a maximum 30 days within a period of 180 days and for an aggregate period of up to 90 days. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to sign the Visa-Exemption Agreement for Ordinary Passport Holders between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Thailand, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Official Communication Facilities for accelerating the Digitalization Process of the Judicial System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-12-15, to implement the 'e-court' project aimed at digitizing all courts in Sri Lanka. As the initial step of this project, digital systems for case management are currently being developed for Magistrate's Courts, District Courts, and High Courts. A fundamental requirement for this initiative is the provision of official email facilities to officials at all levels of the judicial system. Furthermore, the need to provide 'Voice-to-Text' technology which converts spoken statements into written text in real-time, has been identified as a solution to the current shortage of stenographers in the courts. Similarly, in accordance with the provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Act, No.07 of 2025 and the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act, No.4 of 2015, video conferencing facilities must be provided to all courts to enable online court hearings. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to initially provide 1,050 official email accounts bearing the 'courts.gov.lk' domain to 350 courts under the Government's official information portal (gov.lk), and to host the proposed 1,050 official email accounts through the email system currently utilized by the Ministry of Justice and National Integration, which includes integrated Voice-to-Text and Video Conferencing features, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Establishment of a Political Consultation Mechanism between Lithuania and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - This year marks the 30th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between Lithuania and Sri Lanka. Both parties have proposed that it would be appropriate to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), enabling to establish a political consultation mechanism for further advancing diplomatic relations, enhancing bilateral cooperation and promoting shared objectives. This MoU is expected to promote, strengthen, and expand bilateral cooperation and relations including political, economic, commercial, scientific, technical, and cultural aspects. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment, and Tourism to sign the Memorandum of Understanding on Establishment of a Political Consultation Mechanism, between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Lithuania and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment, and Tourism of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of the Programme for provision of relief to people affected by the war situation in the Middle East
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Action was previously taken to provide a fuel subsidy to consumers during the months of April, May, and June in the year 2026, with a view to mitigating the impact caused to the day-to-day lives of the general public and the overall economy due to the increase in global petroleum prices resulting from the conflict situation prevailing in the Middle East region. As the conflict persists, Government intervention has become essential to further alleviate the impact on the lives of the people. Accordingly, the Government has planned to provide a subsidy on the selling price of Auto Diesel and Industrial Diesel for a period of next 03 months enabling to maintain fuel prices at an affordable level for consumers without increasing fuel prices in the country in line with the increase in the global market thereby offering relief to the general public. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to allocate funds for providing this relief, subject to monthly limits of Rs.15 billion for October, Rs.13.5 billion for November, and Rs.12.15 billion for December, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bill to amend the Trust Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-12-18 to amend the Trust Ordinance No.9 of 1917, incorporating the amendments proposed by the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, upon the observations made by the Task Force on Anti Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Trust (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and subsequently present it to Parliament for approved, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project for the preparation of Baseline Maps for Water Resources Monitoring and Regulation in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - There is a pressing need for a structured, reliable, and scientifically based groundwater information system capable of assisting informed decision making with longterm sustainability in addressing challenges such as contamination of groundwater sources, rising demand of ground water, and alterations in rainfall patterns and recharge processes driven by climate change. However, owing to the fact that data accumulated by the Water Resources Board over the years are scattered and not geo-referenced, it has become difficult to effectively utilize these data for spatial analysis and comprehensive groundwater management. Further, the underutilization of Geographic Information System (GIS) tools in groundwater management processes has constrained the development of advanced spatial models and mapping systems. Therefore, it has been planned to prepare Baseline Maps for Water Resources Monitoring and Regulation in                    Sri Lanka. This initiative will enhance the quality and reliability of groundwater data and strengthen the regulatory capacity of the Water Resources Board, thereby facilitating licensing, assessment, law enforcement, and policy implementation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to implement the project over a three-year period commencing from the year 2027, at an estimated cost of Rs. 180 million, focusing on five key districts: Kurunegala, Anuradhapura, Gampaha, Jaffna, and Hambantota, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing the Automated Passenger Clearance Gates installed at the Bandaranaike International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-05-19 for the purchase and installation of four (04) Automated Passenger Clearance Gates at the Bandaranaike International Airport. Further, in conjunction with issuance of the e-passports planned to be introduced in the year 2027, it is expected to expand the Automated Passenger Clearance Gate facility previously restricted to                       Sri Lankans also for the foreign nationals arriving in and departing from the country. Also, considering the steady rise in the number of air passenger driven by rapid growth in the business and tourism sectors, the need to increase the total number of automated passenger clearance gates to 12 has also been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to commence the process of procuring and installing a total 12 Automated Passenger Clearance Gates comprising of another 08 gates in addition to the 04 Automated Passenger Clearance Gates for which approval has already been granted by the Cabinet, by following the formal procurement procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Baseline Road Extension Project- Phase III-Improvement of the Road Section from Kirulapona Junction to Dutugamunu Street on Colombo -Horana Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Under Phase III of the Baseline Road Extension Project, it has been planned to upgrade a road section of 0.86 km from Kirulapone Junction to Dutugemunu Street on the Colombo-Horana Road into a six-lane with infrastructure facilities such as an underpass, signalized intersections, pedestrian facilities, and drainage system improvements. Bids have been invited for the purpose using the National Competitive Bidding procedure. Based on the recommendations submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee upon the evaluation of seven (07) bids received for the same, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to award the relevant contract to Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd., substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum of Rs.2.89 billion (excluding Value Added Tax), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment a Frequency Management and Monitoring System and a Quality of Service and Quality of Experience System for the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-10-21, for the Ministry of Digital Economy and the Department of External Resources to work together with the Asian Development Bank as an international development partner for advancing the 'Digital Transformation Project.' The Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka, a key implementing agency of this project, requires a Frequency Management and Monitoring System and a Quality of Service and Quality of Experience System. The estimated external financing for the purpose has been identified as US$ 9.25 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy, to procure the ‘Frequency Management and Monitoring System' and the 'Quality of Service and Quality of Experience System' for the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka under the Asian Development Bank-funded Digital Transformation Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a Rehabilitation and Management Mechanism for maintaining the water quality and environmental integrity of the Gregory Lake, Nuwara Eliya at an optimal level
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Considering the ecological significance of the Gregory Lake in Nuwara Eliya, the lake and its surrounding area were declared as an Environmental Protection Area by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2007-03-05. However, due to the impact of various activities within the catchment area and the vicinity of the lake, it has been observed that the water quality and environmental condition of the lake have significantly deteriorated. The Central Environmental Authority has conducted several studies on the water quality of Gregory Lake, Nuwara Eliya and has confirmed that levels of phosphate, nitrogen, and biochemical oxygen far exceed the standard quality level available in normal water. Accumulation of slit in the reservoir and waterways due to sediment deposition over several decades, the inflow of agricultural runoff including fertilizer and pesticides from the catchment area, the discharge of wastewater and solid waste into the lake as a result of urban activities have been found as key factors contributing to the deterioration of the quality of the water. Taking these factors into account, and considering the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to establish a coordinated, science-based mechanism for the sustainable maintenance of water quality and the surrounding environment of Gregory Lake and its catchment area, the Cabinet decided to appoint an Oversight and Management Committee chaired by the Deputy Minister of Environment, as well as an Officials’ Committee comprising of the representatives from relevant state institutions designated as the ‘Gregory Lake Conservation and Rehabilitation Working Committee’.

description: Appointment of a Committee for Restitution of Sri Lankan Cultural Heritage in Foreign Possession
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with Articles 7 and 13 of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Convention of 1970 on the Means of Prohibiting and Preventing the Illicit Import, Export and Transfer of Ownership of Cultural Property, a state is vested with the right to request the return of cultural property that belongs to it and is currently being held abroad to the State to which such cultural property belongs. As per a request made by the then Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs, six (06) artifacts including the Cannon of Lewke Dissawe, two (02) large guns, two (02) Kasthane and a knife with scabbards, were officially returned to Sri Lanka from the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam, Netherlands, in 2023 as the Phase I of the Restitution of Sri Lankan Cultural Heritage. It has been observed appropriate to appoint a Steering Committee to facilitate direct dialogue with the Netherlands Committee regarding the restitution process of cultural artifacts and to advise the Government of Sri Lanka on the Restitution of Sri Lankan Cultural Heritage taken away from the country during the colonial era. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to appoint a Committee titled the 'Committee for Restitution of Sri Lankan Cultural Heritage in Foreign Possession' under the Chairmanship of the Additional Secretary (Cultural Promotion and Foreign) of the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs, to provide necessary guidance to the Government of Sri Lanka in the restitution process of artifacts which were taken away from the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ten - Year National Plan for the Social Care Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2024-07-22, granted approval for the National Social Protection Policy of Sri Lanka. The National Social Protection Strategy of Sri Lanka has been presented to the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-09-15 for its practical implementation and the Cabinet has decided to direct all relevant Ministry Secretaries to take necessary action to comply with the said Strategy. The National Social Security Policy is based on 04 core pillars of social assistance, social care, social insurance, labor market and productive inclusion. Accordingly, the National Action Plan for the Social Care Sector (2026-2035) for the field of social care has been formulated as the tool for the practical implementation of the said Strategy. Accordingly, the joint proposal submitted by the Minister of Labour, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs and the Minister of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment to implement the National Action Plan for the Social Care Sector (2026-2035) in accordance with the National Social Protection Policy of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Technical Cooperation Agreement between the Federative Republic of Brazil and the Democratic Socialist Republic of               Sri Lanka for the Development of the Diary Industry in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Basic Agreement on Technical Cooperation was signed between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Federative Republic of Brazil on 2008-09-16. In accordance with the said Agreement, a high-level delegation comprising experts of the Brazil undertook a technical observation visit to Sri Lanka in 2023 to conduct a comprehensive study regarding the provision of Brazilian technical assistance for the development and capacity building in dairy production and sugarcane cultivation sectors in Sri Lanka. Based on the observations of the said Technical Team and a Concept Paper submitted by the National Science Foundation to the Brazilian Cooperation Agency, both parties have agreed to draft a Cooperation Agreement including the logical framework for implementing a project to develop the dairy industry under Basic Agreement on Technical Cooperation signed in the year 2008. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to sign a Cooperation Agreement to implement the project for developing Sri Lanka's dairy industry, between the Brazilian Cooperation Agency of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Brazil, the Federal University of Viçosa, and the Government of Sri Lanka as well as to sign the Complementary Adjustment Agreement between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Federative Republic of Brazil, which is a prerequisite for the implementation of said cooperation agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the revised National Curriculum Framework under Education Reforms
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-03-01, for the new National Curriculum Framework of which the formulation was initiated by the National Institute of Education in 2019 under the education reform process and its implementation methodology. However, taking into account that the relevant modules for Grades 1, 6, and 10 for the implementation of new education reforms had been completed by the National Institute of Education by the time the new Government assumed office in 2024, it was planned to implement the new National Curriculum Framework solely for Grades 1 and 6 in the year 2026, while ensuring appropriate alignment with the new Government's policies. Similarly, it was also decided to introduce vocational subjects starting from Grade 10 onwards. Accordingly, the Concept Paper outlining the necessary steps for 'Transforming General Education in Sri Lanka', formulated to make the relevant stakeholders aware, justifying the proposed adjustments was submitted to the Parliamentary SubCommittee on Education Reforms on 2025-10-22. Subsequently, as decided at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-01-13, action was taken to postpone the implementation of education reforms for Grade 6 planned under the first phase of the broader reform agenda for general education until 2027, and to proceed only with the implementation of new curriculum reforms for Grade 1 in 2026. Following this, the Ministry of Education, Higher Education, and Vocational Education has taken the following measures:

Re-reviewing the Concept Paper prepared with regard to 'Transforming General Education in Sri Lanka' by the National Education Commission, and re-drafting a new Concept Paper including policy recommendations.


Reviewing the Concept Paper re-drafted so by the National Steering Committee on New Education Reforms established as per the Cabinet decision dated 2026-03-23 and by the Sub-Committees appointed under the five key pillars of education reforms of curriculum reform viz. human resource development, educational administration reform and infrastructure development, evaluation and assessment and public awareness and promotion and obtaining further observations and recommendations.


Further revising the National Curriculum Framework compiled by the National Institute of Education in 2023 based on the said observations and recommendations, and obtaining approval from the Academic Affairs Board of the National Institute of Education.


Obtaining approval of the Council of the National Institute of Education for the National Curriculum Framework, which has already been approved by the Academic Affairs Board of the Institute.


Obtaining concurrence of the National Steering Committee on New Education Reforms on 2026-08-13, for the National Curriculum Framework approved by the Council of the National Institute of Education.


Printing and preparing Activity Books and Teachers' Guides for all three terms of Grade 1 and Grade 2 for the year 2027, so as to ensure the continuation of the primary education reforms initiated in the year 2026.


Preparing modules for Terms I, II, and III for Grade 6, as well as Teachers' Guides covering all 03 terms.


Master trainers have already been trained by the National Institute of Education for all primary and secondary subjects and formulating provincial-level plans for teacher training.


Preparation of the policy guideline on school-based assessment and evaluation by the Assessment and Evaluation Sub-committee, designed for practical implementation by utilizing existing resources within the school system and obtaining approval from the National Steering Committee for the same.

- Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education, and Vocational Education, to proceed with the education reform process for Grade 1 initiated in the year 2026 and to commence and continue to implement the education reform process for Grades 2 and 6 in 2027, based on the Concept Paper prepared by the National Education Commission, the National Curriculum Framework and the Guidelines on School-based Assessment and Evaluation approved by the National Steering Committee for New Education Reforms, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of Irrigation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Dr. (Eng.) K. Weligepolage, presently serving as the Director General of Irrigation, is scheduled to retire from the public service on 2026-10-06, upon reaching the mandatory age of retirement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land, and Irrigation to appoint Eng. P.M. Jayadeera, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, presently serving as the Additional Secretary (Water Resources Development) of the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land, and Irrigation, to the vacant post of Director General of Irrigation, with effect from 2026-10-06, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka Cricket Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-06-08 to prepare a Bill to restructure Sri Lanka Cricket. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has prepared the Sri Lanka Cricket Bill to make provisions for the Establishment of Sri Lanka Cricket, its powers and functions for Control, Governance, Regulation, Promotion, Development and Administration of Cricket in Sri Lanka; to foster the growth of the sport of cricket through principles of good governance, integrity, transparency, accountability, inclusivity and providing equal opportunity, to safeguard the welfare of all participants and protect cricket from corruption and other malpractices. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill. The proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and subsequently present it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Facilitating for the transportation of aviation fuel from Muthurajawela to the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA), Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the cabinet meeting held on 2024-07-29 to implement a project comprising the construction of an aviation fuel storage tank complex with a capacity of 92,000 cubic meters and associated facilities at Muthurajawela; the construction of a dedicated fuel pipeline connecting this storage facility to the refuelling terminal at the Bandaranaike International Airport; and the execution of necessary modifications to the existing terminal at Muthurajawela. Accordingly, bids have been invited following the International Competitive Bidding Procedure, and three (03) bids have been submitted for the same. Based on the recommendation made by the High-Level Procurement Committee following the evaluation of the said bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the contract to M/s. China Petroleum Pipeline Engineering Company Limited, the substantially responsive bidder for a sum of US$ 40.84 million and LKR 8,548.75 million (inclusive of taxes), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding contracts for the Rehabilitation and Improvement of Roads under the Rural Road Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Bids have been invited using the National Competitive Procurement Procedure to select contractors for the rehabilitation and improvement of five (05) rural road packages in the Western and Northern Provinces under the Rural Road Programme. Seventeen (17) bids have been submitted for the purpose. Based on the recommendations of the High-Level Procurement Committee following  evaluation of the said bids, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to award contracts for three (03) of the five (05) packages as follows:

Awarding the contract for Package No. 02 for the rehabilitation and Improvement of Rural Roads in the Kalutara District of the Western Province, to M/s RR Construction (Pvt) Ltd., substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum of Rs.659.05 million (excluding Value Added Tax).


Awarding the contract for Package No. 01 for the Rehabilitation and Improvement of Rural Roads in the Kilinochchi District of the Northern Province,to M/s RR Construction (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum of Rs.801.74 million (excluding VAT).


Awarding the contract for Package No. 02, for the Rehabilitation and Improvement of Rural Roads in the Mullaitivu District of the Northern Province,to M/s RR Construction (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum of Rs.659.12 million (excluding VAT).

description: Purchase of vehicles for the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation performs vital functions such as mitigating flood risks in urban and low-lying areas, efficiently maintaining drainage systems, conducting emergency operations during floods, and maintaining canals. The need has been found to further strengthen the internal operational capacity of the Corporation to execute these tasks efficiently and expeditiously. Therefore, it has been planned to purchase small-scale machinery suitable for clearing the narrow canals that significantly contribute to urban flooding. The General Treasury has agreed to provide Rs. 625 million to the Corporation as an equity contribution for the purchase of these machinery. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to purchase the relevant machinery for the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation utilizing the said sum along with the Corporation's own funds, at a total estimated cost of Rs. 1,233 million, following formal procurement procedures, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Utilization of loan facilities granted by the Government of India for the rehabilitation and reconstruction programmes of Sri Lanka in the aftermath of the Cyclone Ditwah
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In order to implement the rehabilitation and reconstruction programmes subsequent to the Cyclone Ditwah, the Government of India has provided a longterm loan facility of US$ 250 million and a short-term loan facility of US$ 100 million under 'Operation Sagar Bandhu' through the Indian Rupee Lines of Credit.  Under the said short-term loan facility, a sum of US$ 5 million has been proposed to be allocated for the importation of breeding animals from India to support the development of the livestock sector. Plans have also been made to utilize the remaining US$ 95 million of the short-term loan facility to purchase essential vehicles such as ambulances, gully bowsers, single-cabs, and tipper trucks required to facilitate service delivery and relief operations in areas severely affected by the Cyclone Ditwah. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to purchase the aforementioned essential vehicles for the Ministry of Defence; the Ministry of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs; and the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government and the institutions under their purview, under the said Indian short-term loan facility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 05 million Pre-Printed Polycarbonate Cards for the issuance of National Identity Cards
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-04-07, granted approval to initiate the procurement process for purchasing the pre-printed polycarbonate cards required for issuing National Identity Cards, for the Department for Registration of Persons. Accordingly, bids were invited using the international competitive bidding procedure and eight bids were submitted for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy to award the contract for the purchase of 05 million pre-printed polycarbonate cards to Muhlbauer ID Services GmbH of Germany, the substantially responsive bidder, for a sum of EURO 4.93 million, based on the recommendation of the High Level Procurement Committee submitted after evaluating said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Project to Build a Safe, Skilled and Strong Community for Families resettled at the Kalinga Mawatha Housing Complex, Colombo 05 constructed under the Urban Regeneration Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Kalinga Mawatha Housing Complex in Colombo 05 comprises 528 housing units and 384 of these are occupied by families relocated from underserved urban settlements. Although these residents have secured permanent houses, it has been observed that they face various complex socio-economic challenges due to the change in their traditional lifestyles. Therefore, the Agromart Outreach Foundation has submitted a proposal to implement a project aimed at empowering these families through a multi-sectoral intervention. It has been planned to implement the relevant project on empowering low-income urban women within a period of 03 three years covering key areas of needs assessment, economic transformation, comprehensive family support, and sustainable integration under the same. The Ministry of Women and Child Affairs provides the necessary policy guidance and administrative support and the Agromart Outreach Foundation provides the technical expertise and funding required for implementation. The Urban Development Authority will be involved as the facilitating agency. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to implement the proposed project and to sign the Memorandum of Understanding for the same between the Ministry of Women and Child Affairs and the Agromart Outreach Foundation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Cabinet Sub-Committee for organizing the                                     79th Independence Day Commemoration Ceremony
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to appoint a Cabinet Sub Committee headed by the Hon. Prime Minister and with the participation of the relevant Hon. Ministers to oversee and provide guidance for conducting the 79th Independence Day Commemoration Ceremony that falls on 2027-02-04, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between Indonesia and Sri Lanka on Bilateral Consultations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 75th Anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between Indonesia and Sri Lanka falls in 2027. Accordingly, both Parties have agreed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Bilateral Consultations to further develop, strengthen and increase bilateral relations between the two countries. This MoU will facilitate the evaluation of bilateral relations, the exchange points of views on bilateral and international issues, the coordination of positions on issues of mutual interest, and the holding of regular bilateral consultations. As such, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the Memorandum of Understanding on Bilateral Consultations between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Indonesia and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism of Sri Lanka effective for a period of 05 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a new Management Framework for the Dr. Neville Fernando Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Pursuant to a decision made at the Cabinet meeting held on 2017-06-27, the administration of the Dr. Neville Fernando Hospital was vested with the Ministry in charge of the subject of Health, with effect from 2017-08-01. Subsequently, approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-02-09, to manage the hospital under the Sri Lanka Air Force as per a hybrid operational model and to operate it as a State-owned enterprise incorporated under the Companies Act. Accordingly, the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, the Ministry of Defence, the Ministry of Health and Mass Media, and the Sri Lanka Air Force have jointly proposed a governance and financial framework for the management of the Dr. Neville Fernando Hospital. Under this proposed management framework, the Dr. Neville Fernando Hospital provides inward and OPD treatment to the public on free-of-charge basis as well as fee-levying basis. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, and the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the proposed management framework as follows, was approved by the Cabinet:

Transferring the hospital's ownership and assets to a Company where the General Treasury possesses 100% shareholding, and entrusting the hospital's management to the Sri Lanka Air Force.


Appointment of an 11-member Board of Directors for the proposed Company by the Secretary to the Treasury, based on the recommendation of the Secretary to the Ministry of Defence.


Provision of funds pertaining to the staff salaries and operational expenses of the proposed Company for the period of 2026-2028 and thereafter maintaining the said hospital as a self-financing entity.


Supplying drugs, medical supplies, and other consumables with an estimated value of Rs.125 million annually to the hospital, from provisions allocated to the Ministry of Health and Mass Media for the free health services provided by the hospital to the public.

description: Submission of the Appropriation Bill for the Fiscal Year 2027 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-06-30 to prepare the Appropriation Bill for the fiscal year 2027. Accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Appropriation Bill for the fiscal year 2027 prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same, thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Designation of a Business as a Primary Business of Strategic Importance under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with section 53 of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act No.11 of 2021, provisions have been made for designating a business as a Business of Strategic Importance and granting exemptions or incentives for such businesses, subject to approval of the Cabinet. Accordingly, Prime Melwa (Private) Limited proposed to be designated as a Primary Business of Strategic Importance plans to invest US$ 112.2 million and LKR 15.9 billion over the coming years to implement a landmark mixed-use waterfront development project within the Colombo Port City, thereby generating employment opportunities for approximately 800 individuals. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to grant the proposed exemptions or incentives to Prime Melwa (Private) Limited in accordance with the provisions of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act and to designate the said venture as a Primary Business of Strategic Importance.

description: Implementation of Health Sector Projects to improve Public Health Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to implement development projects aimed at preventing the shortages of infrastructure facilities identified as lacking in many Government healthcare institutions including hospitals to meet the increasing health services demands of the people and upgrading facilities in compliance with modern healthcare standards through the development of state-of-the-art infrastructure facilities. Accordingly, following an evaluation of 41 project proposals submitted during the years 2025 and 2026, the Department of National Planning has recommended to commence and implement those projects in 2027. The said project proposals have already been incorporated into the Public Investment Programme pertaining to the period of 2027-2031.
