It has been planned to allocate provisions for the implementation of 39 projects out of those projects through the budget 2027, taking into account the state of readiness of the said projects. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the said 39 new projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for the provision of Global Network Infrastructure Services to SriLankan Airlines Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A secure, resilient, and high-performance global network infrastructure platform is required for the seamless connectivity among critical aviation systems including Passenger Service Systems, Departure Control Systems, Reservations and ticketing platforms, Cargo Management Systems, and Airport Operational Systems. Accordingly, bids have been invited following the International Competitive Bidding method to select a new service provider upon the expiration of the period of contract for the provision of relevant services to SriLankan Airlines Limited. Only a single bid was submitted for the purpose. Accordingly, based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the contract for the provision of Global Network Infrastructure Services to SriLankan Airlines  Limited for a period of five years from 2026-10-01, to 2031-09-30, for a sum of US$ 4.01 million to SITA Switzerland SARL, the only substantially responsive bidder, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Blackpool-Ambewela-Pattipola-Hortain Plains Road(B 512) section from 5+200 km to 12+000 km
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the national competitive bidding procedure for the improvement of the Blackpool-Ambewela-Pattipola-Horton plains Road (B 512) section from 5+200 km to 12+000 km, which was damaged by the Cyclone Ditwah which affected Sri Lanka in late November 2025. Four (04) bids have been received for the same. Following the evaluation of the bids, based on the recommendations of the High-Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to award the relevant contract to M/s Asset Engineering (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum of Rs.791.68 million (excluding taxes), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dikwella Beruwala Storm water Drainage System and Public Facilities Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Wavurukannala area, a suburban area located close to the Dikwella town, is constantly subject to flooding. The primary cause for this issue is the inadequate drainage resulting from the reclamation of the swamp called Beruwala and narrowing of the canal routes due to the informal urbanization on either side of the main canal named Sandis Ela. In that context, the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation conducted a hydrological study of the area and prepared plans required to upgrade the drainage system and formal recommendations and approvals have been received from the relevant agencies pertaining to those plans. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to implement the 'Dikwella-Beruwala Stormwater Drainage System and Public Facilities Improvement Project' during the period of 2027-2030 at an estimated cost of Rs.2,946 million, and to carry out following activities thereunder:

Restoring an area of ​​approximately 14 acres of the Beruwala low-lying lands as a water retention area (a lake).


Preparing the tank bund spanning approximately 1.8 kilometers as the Perahera Mawatha and as a walking path for the general public.


Widening the Sandis Canal which carries rainwater from the swamp to the lagoon and developing the same also with a service path.


Preparing a new canal extending from the proposed lake to the lagoon via the Beliatta alternative route, along with the development of other secondary canals.


Upgrading the existing culverts on roads crossing the canal, as well as those associated with the lake.


Developing public amenities in compliance with the needs of the area surrounding the proposed reservoir.

description: Storm Water Drainage and Environment Project adjacent to the Piliyandala-Kesbewa Bypass Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Urbanization activities conducted centering around the Piliyandala area over the past decade such as the construction of the Piliyandala-Kesbewa bypass road (Route  No.120) through reclamation of paddy lands, and the construction of the Piliyandala bus terminal under the Piliyandala Town Development Project have adversely affected the natural drainage patterns of the area. Due to the reclamation of low - lying lands, the natural water retention capacity of the land has significantly decreased leading to increased surface runoff and the risk of flooding even during a minor rainfall. Therefore, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to implement the Environment Improvement Project and the Storm Water Drainage System proposed to be constructed in the low-lying area adjacent to the Piliyandala-Kesbewa bypass road for upgrading the existing drainage system and constructing canal banks, rehabilitating existing culverts and constructing new culverts, constructing water retention zones, and designating environmentally sensitive zones within the region as wetlands.

description: Mudun Ela Stormwater Drainage and Environmental Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation has proposed the implementation of the 'Mudun Ela Stormwater Drainage and Environmental Improvement Project' to mitigate stormwater drainage issues that severely impact development in the Peliyagoda and Kelaniya areas, which fall within the Mudun Ela subcatchment area. The proposed project has been designed based on the prefeasibility study of the Mudun Ela basin area conducted by the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) in 2023 and the feasibility study conducted by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation in 2024. Implementation of the said project aims to resolve existing stormwater drainage issues in the Mudun Ela sub-catchment area, minimize the impact and damage caused by flooding to ongoing development projects and economic activities, and release land required for future development activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to implement the 'Mudun Ela Stormwater Drainage and Environmental Improvement Project' in a phased out manner during the period of 2027-2036, under an estimated total cost of Rs.46,190.6 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of the Project to protect the boundaries and conservation areas of the selected major reservoirs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet granted its approval on 2025-06-16, for the Department of Irrigation to implement a project by using the provisions of Rs.100 million allocated to the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation for the year 2025 under the 'Clean Sri Lanka' Project, in order to accurately mark the boundaries of major reservoirs controlled under the Department of Irrigation by utilizing boundary posts of the said Department, as one step toward conserving water resources that have been affected by current land use patterns. Accordingly, activities of 21 selected reservoirs currently subject to various impacts commenced in the year 2025, and marking the boundaries and installing boundary posts of Nuwara Wewa, Kantale Wewa, and Tissa Wewa have been completed within the same year. Additionally, the remaining work of 48 reservoirs included in the relevant project proposal for which the approval of the Department of National Planning was granted is scheduled to be completed in the ensuing years. Accordingly, the estimated cost for the entire project for the period of 2025-2028 including surveying, casting and installing of boundary posts, and tree planting of remaining reservoirs has been calculated at Rs.400 million. The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land, and Irrigation to continue implementing the said project through the Department of Irrigation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting additional provisions to the Paddy Marketing Board to purchase paddy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A sum of Rs. 6,000 million, allocated under the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to implement the paddy purchasing programme for the Yala Season 2026, has been released to the Paddy Marketing Board and the Board is currently engaged in purchasing paddy using the said funds. Nevertheless, as the harvesting of paddy has not yet been completed in the Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, Puttalam, Mannar, and Mullaitivu Districts, as well as in the Mahaweli B, C, and H Zones, it has been observed that the currently allocated funds are inadequate for purchasing paddy in those areas. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to release an additional Rs.2,500 million out of the Rs.7,500 million in additional funds allocated to the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, to the Paddy Marketing Board on a reimbursement basis, in order to implement the accelerated paddy purchasing programme for purchase of paddy for the Yala Season 2026, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting the 8th Commonwealth Parliamentary Association (CPA) Asia Regional Conference and 3rd Joint CPA Asia and CPA South-East Asia Regional Conference by the Parliament of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to hold the 8th Asia Regional Conference of the Commonwealth Parliamentary Association (CPA) and 3rd Joint CPA Asia and CPA South-East Asia Regional Conference in Colombo over three days in April/May 2027. Approximately 90 delegates, including Speakers, Deputy Speakers, Members of Parliament, and Parliamentary officials representing CPA member jurisdictions of the Commonwealth Parliamentary Association within the Asia and South-East Asian Regions, are expected to participate in these Conferences. The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister for the Parliament of Sri Lanka to host the said conferences was approved by the Cabinet, taking into account the opportunities to strengthen parliamentary diplomacy and regional cooperation, as well as to enhance the international standing of the Parliament of Sri Lankan within the Commonwealth Parliamentary Association.

description: Hosting the SAARC Training Workshop on Financial Modeling for Renewable Energy Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Energy Centre of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation has planned to conduct a training workshop under the theme 'Financial Modeling for Renewable Energy Projects' in Colombo from 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-07. Two delegates from each SAARC member country, including Sri Lanka, are scheduled to attend the said workshop. The Energy Centre of SAARC will provide all local hospitality and airport transport facilities, excluding airfare. The Cabinet, having considered the proposals submitted by the Minister of Energy regarding this workshop which is significant for capacity building of Government officials and other relevant stakeholders in project evaluation and financial modeling within the renewable energy sector, decided to grant the concurrence for Sri Lanka to host the said programme.

description: Declaration of a 'National Children's Day Week'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Children's Day is celebrated in Sri Lanka on 1st October every year with the aim of further enhancing the attention of the society with regard to children's rights, protection, education, health, and well-being. It has been observed that the challenges children face today extend beyond traditional child protection issues, encompassing risks associated with the internet and digital technology, mental and psychosocial pressures, neglect, and various socio-economic vulnerabilities. Furthermore, the need to enhance awareness of children’s rights and protection not only among children but also among all stakeholders who regularly interact with children, including parents, teachers, Government officials, service providers and the general public, has been identified. Therefore, plans have been made to declare a 'National Children's Day Week', coinciding with the National Children's Day Celebration with the objectives of enhancing public awareness of children’s rights, fostering social sensitivity towards children, and improving community participation in child protection. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to declare the period from 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-01, as 'National Children's Day Week - 2026' and to implement special programmes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting the 'Disrupt Asia - 2026' Tech Conference and Innovation Festival
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-14 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Digital Economy and GovTech Sri Lanka (Pvt) Ltd. have planned to host a National Tech Conference and Innovation Festival titled 'Disrupt Asia 2026'. The said Conference and Festival are expected to be conducted as a two-day event featuring a venture competition, dynamic plenaries, an exhibition, networking reception and other side events. A wide range of key stakeholders including Ministries and Government entities, private sector, industry stakeholders, academia, development partners, and international organizations are expected to participate in the same. The UNDP Sri Lanka has expressed its interest and readiness to serve as a Strategic Partner to the Ministry of Digital Economy for the 'Disrupt Asia 2026' Conference and Festival. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy, to hold the 'Disrupt Asia 2026' National Tech Conference and Innovation Festival in collaboration with the UNDP Sri Lanka as a Strategic Partner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prevention of Organized Crimes Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-03-30 to prepare a new Bill for Prevention of Organized Crimes in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has prepared the Prevention of Organized Crimes Bill to provide legal provisions for the enforcement of the United Nations Convention against Transnational Organized Crime, to prevent and combat serious crimes through effective national and international cooperation, and also to protect society from the threats posed by organized crime groups. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration; and the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to publish the Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presidential Road Safety Awards Ceremony - 2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 'Presidential Road Safety Awards Ceremony - 2026', a project identified under the Road Safety Action Plan 2025-2026, has been planned to be held at the national level. It is expected that the holding of the Presidential Awards Ceremony will appreciate the exceptional contributions made by individuals, public and private institutions, organizations and other parties towards road safety at the national level and further enhance the attention of the society, responsible behaviour and public participation regarding road safety. Based on the experiences and results of the inaugural awards ceremony to be held this year, the said ceremony will be held every year in the future, in conjunction with the World Day of Remembrance for Road Traffic Victims, which falls on the 3rd Sunday of November. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to hold the 'Presidential Road Safety Awards Ceremony - 2026' at the national level and to present merit awards and Presidential awards to the awardees selected at the said event, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Digital Transformation Units in Government Institutions to operationalize the National Digital Economy Blueprint
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-10-21 for the National Digital Economy Blueprint 2025-2030. In order to implement the said Blueprint, the need to establish a robust and standardized institutional mechanism within government institutions to control the sectoral digital transformation and ensure compliance with the National Digital Public Infrastructure Initiative, has been identified. Accordingly, it has been proposed to establish a unit called the 'Digital Transformation Unit' in all government institutions as a dedicated unit to properly manage and coordinate digital transformation. A Digital Transformation Unit Reference Framework, which includes the structure for the establishment and implementation of such units, has been prepared by GovTech Sri Lanka (Private) Limited. According to the said framework, it has been planned to appoint a Chief Digital Officer (CDO) who will report directly to the Head of the Institution as the Head of the Digital Transformation Unit. The unit will also provide government institutions with the opportunity to obtain expertise from GovTech Sri Lanka (Private) Limited for enterprise architecture, data and artificial intelligence support, cybersecurity guidelines, interoperability support and advisory services. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as Minister of Digital Economy to establish Digital Transformation Units within government institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding the 'Colombo Marathon-2026' in connection with the 50th National Sports Festival
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In connection with the 50th National Sports Festival, the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, the Department of Sports Development and other relevant institutions have jointly planned to hold an international marathon competition titled 'Colombo Marathon - 2026' at the Galle Face Green, Colombo on                         13th September 2026, with the aim of promoting sports culture and tourism. It is expected that a large number of national and international competitors will participate in the competition, which will include full marathon, half marathon, 10 km run and 5 km Fun Run. The Cabinet took into consideration the submissions made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports regarding the implementation plan of the competition, prize money to be given to the winners and the roadmap for the competition.

description: Procurement for relaying of the 400m, 200m and 80m synthetic running tracks available under the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted by the Cabinet decisions dated 2025-10-21 and 2026-03-03 to implement the Project of relaying of the 400m, 200m and 80m synthetic running tracks under the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex Authority, at an estimated cost of Rs. 1,062.543 million. Bids have been invited following the international competitive bidding method to select a contractor to implement the said project, and 03 bids have been submitted for the same. After evaluating the bids, the High Level Procurement Committee has recommended that bids be re-invited for the said procurement, considering that the only qualified bidder has submitted a bid value 70% higher than the estimated cost of the project. Based on the said recommendations, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to re-invite bids to select a suitable contractor to implement the project for the relaying of the 400m, 200m and 80m synthetic running tracks available under the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex Authority.

description: Procurement of Consultancy Services for preparation of detailed designs of the Sustainable Tourism Sector Development Programme and provision of project implementation facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to improve tourism amenities in the areas of Dambulla (Sigiriya) and Trincomalee, and to renovate and upgrade infrastructure facilities at selected sites of tourist attractions, under the Sustainable Tourism Sector Development Programme, which is implemented under a loan of US$ 30 million from the Asian Development Bank. The Ministry of Transport, Highways and Urban Development has invited expressions of interest to select a consultancy firm to prepare detailed plans of the said programme and to facilitate the project implementation. After evaluating the expressions of interest submitted by 15 consultancy firms, proposals have been invited from 06 firms. Accordingly, 05 proposals have been submitted, and after evaluating the said proposals, the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee has recommended to award the said consultancy service contract to M/s Resources Development Consultants (Pvt) Ltd., (Sri Lanka), in association with M/s Novel Interdisciplinary Consulting Enterprise (Pvt) Ltd., (Sri Lanka) for a sum of Rs.173.86 million (excluding VAT). The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the relevant consultancy service contract as per the said recommendation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Progress of implementing the Disaster Relief Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet of Ministers has been granted for the implementation of the RE-MSME- Disaster Relief Loan Scheme for reviving the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise sector affected by Cyclone Ditwah and the implementation of the Extended Disaster Relief (EDR) Loan Scheme to provide financial assistance to disaster-affected businesses. An amount of Rs.10,000 million has been allocated for the implementation of the said loan schemes in the years 2025 and 2026. These 02 loan schemes have been implemented as an integrated programme since 2026 with the aim of providing immediate financial relief to resume all businesses after the disaster and to restore the country's economy quickly. Accordingly, action has been taken to provide loans amounting to Rs.8,061.4 million for 3,968 enterprises affected by the Ditwah disaster under the said loan scheme in collaboration with 15 Participatory Financial Institutions. The Cabinet noted the information on the progress of the implementation of the said loan scheme which was presented by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development.

description: Implementation of the Promoting Resilience and Opportunity for Inclusive Recovery - Sector Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Approximately 56% of the population in Sri Lanka faces multi-risk conditions, that adversely affect women, youth, the elderly, persons with disabilities, and rural and estate communities. As climate change further intensifies this situation, the need to strengthen social protection, employment and livelihood opportunities, and elderly care services has been identified. Accordingly, it has been planned to implement the Promoting Resilience and Opportunity for Inclusive Recovery - Sector Development Programme under an Asian Development Bank concessionary loan of USD 100 million. The said programme is expected to be implemented in the 6 Districts of Kegalle, Matale, Mullaitivu, Killinochchi, Batticaloa, and Nuwara Eliya from November 2026 to October 2031. It is expected to implement the said programme as follows under the 02 components as Policy and Investment, covering 3 areas:

Enhancing the coverage and quality of employment and livelihood services - Granting an initial seed capital of Rs.200,000/- in two tranches for 30,000 "Aswesuma" beneficiary families in 06 selected districts in which the programme intended to be implemented after a formal livelihood development and entrepreneurship training, providing entrepreneurship development support, market and financial services.


Improving social care infrastructure, services, and standards - Introducing regulatory procedures, service standards, and create trained elder care workforce and to strengthen regulatory and institutional environment to provide quality and fair social care services to the elders and establish 05 Elder Care Homes to develop sustainable and quality elder care service.


Establishing inclusive and responsive social security systems and institutional capacity development - Development of a Social Protection Action Plan (2025) and Case Management Framework based on the National Social Protection Policy (2023) and strategies for strengthening the policy and institutional environment in the social security sector, establishing digital and data system, introducing cyber security and data protection, enhancing institutional capacity for integrated and coordinated service delivery and establishing a monitoring, evaluation, and learning system.

- Accordingly, the Cabinet granted approval to implement the Promoting Resilience and Opportunity for Inclusive Recovery - Sector Development Programme as referred to above as per the proposal made by the Minister of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Trade Negotiation Committee and Trade Policy Consultative Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet of Ministers, at its meeting held on 2026-08-24, granted approval for the implementation of the recommendations made by the Committee appointed to conduct a review on Free Trade Agreements and way forward for negotiations on Free Trade Agreements. Taking into account the said recommendations, the need to establish a National Trade Negotiation Committee and a Trade Policy Consultative Committee has been identified for enabling               Sri Lanka to adopt a more focused, sequenced and evidence-based approach to future FTA negotiations and to ensure a sustainable and meaningful stakeholder consultation process for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to pursue action as follows, was approved by the Cabinet.

To establish a National Trade Negotiation Committee to conduct trade negotiations with potential bilateral or regional trading partners.


To appoint the Secretary, Ministry of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Co-operative Development as the Chairman of the National Trade Negotiation Committee and the Chief Trade Negotiator.


To establish 12 subject-specific Sub-Committees together with Technical Working Groups required under the National Trade Negotiation Committee.


To appoint a Trade Policy Consultative Committee comprising of trade experts, researchers engaged in trade-related research, the business community, trade unions, civil society and relevant Government officials to advise the National Trade Negotiation Committee on its operational and technical aspects, to make policy recommendations to the Cabinet on matters related to trade agreements, and to ensure sustainable consultation and communication mechanisms on Free Trade Agreements.


For the Minister entrusted the subject of International Trade and the Minister entrusted the subject of Industry to function as CoChairpersons of the Trade Policy Consultative Committee.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding on Labour Cooperation between Sri Lanka and Thailand and Agreement on the Employment of Sri Lankan Workers in Thailand
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - At the discussions held between Sri Lanka and Thailand with the aim of establishing bilateral cooperation on labour migration, a consensus has been reached to sign a Memorandum of Understanding on Labor Cooperation and a Supplementary Agreement on the employment of Sri Lankan workers in Thailand. The signing of the proposed Agreements is expected to establish formal cooperation between the competent authorities of the two countries in the field of labour, establish a structured mechanism for the transparent and efficient sending and receiving of Sri Lankan workers to Thailand, safeguard the legal rights, welfare and protection of Sri Lankan workers employed in Thailand, and prevent human trafficking. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the Memorandum of Understanding on Labor Cooperation between Sri Lanka and Thailand and the Agreement on the Employment of Sri Lankan Workers in Thailand for a period of 05 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the HelmholtzZentrum für Umweltforschung GmbH-UFZ and the Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-07 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Helmholtz-Zentrum für Umweltforschung GmbH (UFZ), Germany, has planned to implement a research project titled 'SpatioCoexistence-Towards a Spatial Coexistence Theory for Species Rich Communities' with the aim of developing a new spatial ecological theory that provides a deeper understanding of biodiversity, plant communities and ecosystem dynamics by integrating ecological modelling, mathematical approaches and large-scale spatial datasets. The Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka, has been selected as a Specialist Subcontractor to provide ecological datasets related to the project and conduct scientific research activities. It has been proposed to sign an Agreement between the two parties in that regard, and it will provide the opportunity to the Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka to obtain funds up to EUR 50,000 for a period of 05 years to implement the research activities agreed upon between the two parties. The Agreement is expected to facilitate knowledge exchange, access to modern scientific methodologies, capacity development of Sri Lankan researchers and the creation of joint scientific publications, and to ensure the ownership of new research results generated under the collaboration, while protecting the ownership of existing knowledge and information held by each party. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to sign the said Agreement between the Helmholtz-Zentrum für Umweltforschung GmbH UFZ of the Federal Republic of Germany and the Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation between the National Cadet Corps of Sri Lanka and the National Cadet Corps of India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The ongoing youth exchange programmes between the cadet corps of Sri Lanka and India contribute to the expansion of friendly relations between the two countries, and it is proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the two organizations to further strengthen the said cooperation. The said Agreement envisages the implementation of exchange programmes between the cadet corps members of the two countries for the purpose of planning and implementing joint specialized training and leadership programmes. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding for cooperation between the National Cadet Corps of Sri Lanka and the National Cadet Corps of India, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Donation of US Dollars One Million to the Government of Nepal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The devastating flash flood occurred in the Rasuwa District in the Northern Nepal on 2026-08-26 has resulted in causing huge loss of human lives and extensive damages to properties. The severity of the disaster has placed a significant humanitarian burden on the Government and people of Nepal, and relief and recovery assistance is urgently required due to the continuing search for missing persons, the risk of further flooding, and the extensive damage to infrastructure. Taking into consideration the long-standing friendly relations between Sri Lanka and Nepal, based on deep cultural, religious and peopletopeople ties and Sri Lanka's experience in dealing with the devastating humanitarian and economic consequences of major natural disasters, the proposal made by the Hon. President to provide a donation of US$ 1 million as humanitarian assistance to the Government of Nepal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-engineering the Vidatha Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Vidatha Programme was launched in 2005 to bridge the gap between national scientific capacity and rural economic development by making innovations generated through scientific knowledge and research accessible to rural micro, small and medium scale entrepreneurs. Vidatha Resource Centres have been established in 315 Divisional Secretariat Divisions as of now. The current Vidatha operating model, being structurally inflexible and relying on outdated skills and standardized programmes, has failed to adapt to the rapidly changing global market trends, the risks arising from climate change and modern technological advancements. Therefore, at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-11-10 approval has been granted to implement a Strategic Plan 2026-2030 for Vidatha Resources Centres, covering all 315 Vidatha Resource Centres located throughout the country. Under the said plan, each Vidatha Resource Center is expected to be operated under three specialized interconnected cells namely the Scientific Data Cell, the Incubation and Intellectual Property Cell and the Quality and Standards Cell. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Science and Technology, policy approval of the Cabinet was granted to reengineer Vidatha Resource Centers under the new institutional model.

description: Recruitment of Nursing Tutors on contract basis, for the Nursing Schools under the Ministry of Health and Mass Media
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - There are 17 Nursing Schools including the Post Basic College of Nursing under the Ministry of Health and Mass Media. The number of vacancies available in the post of Grade I/Supra Grade Nursing Officer (Education) in those colleges as at 2026-03-31 is 142 and since 24 officers are scheduled to be promoted to the Special Grade based on the vacancies available in the post of Special Grade Nursing Officer (Education) as at 2025-12-31, the total number of vacancies is scheduled to become 166. Also, there are 24 vacancies in the post of Special Grade Nursing Officer (Education). Although necessary steps are being taken to convert nursing schools into nursing faculties and upgrade the Diploma in Nursing to a Degree in Nursing, recruitment for the relevant training for the appointment to the post of Nursing Officer (Education) in Grade I/Supra Grade has not yet been done. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to recruit retired nursing tutors who served in government Nursing Schools and nursing tutors who have retired or legally discharged from the service from nursing schools belonging to the tri-forces, to the post of Nursing Officer (Education) in Grade I/Higher Grade, on contract basis, until the existing vacancies are formally filled.

description: Amendment to the Community Based Corrections Act, No.46 of 1999
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-04-07 to amend the Community Based Corrections Act, No.46 of 1999, by updating the relevant provisions to enable more effective enforcement of law against habitual offenders. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman pursuant to the said approval. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the Community Based Corrections (Amendment) Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Quarantine and Prevention of Diseases Ordinance           No.3 of 1897
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Quarantine and Prevention of Diseases Ordinance No.3 of 1897 is the principal legislation in Sri Lanka governing the prevention of the spread of communicable diseases and the implementation of quarantine measures. However, it has been observed that the risk of transmission of communicable diseases across borders has also increased significantly due to the significant increase in international and domestic movement of persons, goods and services at present, and that frequent international travel and international trade are leading to the rapid spread of communicable diseases between countries. Accordingly, the Cabinet approval had been granted in the year 2016 to amend the Quarantine and Prevention of Diseases Ordinance No.3 of 1897, the said amendment Bill, but it has not yet been submitted to Parliament. Therefore, as per a proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media, the Cabinet approved to appoint a Review Committee to study the currently prepared Amendment Bill taking also into account the experiences gained during the recent pandemics and propose appropriate amendments to address current health challenges as well as future challenges.

description: Submission of the Orders issued under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-03-30 to designate 68 business entities belonging to the sectors of Information Technology, Consultancy Services, Business Process Outsourcing, Logistics, Infrastructure, Hybrid/Combined Business Models and General Enterprises as Secondary Businesses of Strategic Importance under the provisions of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act No.11 of 2021. Accordingly, Orders have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notifications dated 2026-04-10 designating those 68 businesses as Secondary Businesses of Strategic Importance. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the said Orders to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Road Facilities for the 'Tech City Project', Mahenawatta, Pitipana, Homagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 'Tech City Project', Mahenawatta, Pitipana, Homagama has been initiated with the aim of making a high contribution to the country's economy based on innovation and knowledge-centered technology. The construction of the Western Bypass Road from Homagama, Walawwatta via Katuwana has been initiated in the year 2020 with the aim of providing direct access to the Tech City by avoiding traffic congestion in Homagama city. About 50 meters of the road section remains to be constructed to connect that road with the High Level Road. Further, it is planned to connect the Pitipana, Dampe road with the Kottawa-Talagala road through the interior of the Tech City via the access road from Sri Lanka Green University to the Sri Lanka Institute of Biotechnology. Approximately 650 meters of the said road remains to be constructed. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to complete the road section connecting the Western Bypass Road (Homagama, Walawwatta to Katuwana) to the High Level Road and the remaining construction work of the road from Sri Lanka Green University to Sri Lanka Institute of Biotechnology using local funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of the Humanitarian De-mining Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The primary objectives of the de-mining programme are to clear the landmines laid in Northern and Eastern Provinces during the conflict situation which prevailed in such Provinces, and release lands for re-settlement of families who were living in those areas to restore the normal livelihood of such families and development of necessary infrastructure facilities. Accordingly, in the year 2002, the activities of the Humanitarian De-mining Programme initiated by the United Nations Development Programme were carried out by local and foreign Non-Government Organizations and the Humanitarian De-mining Unit of the Sri Lanka Army. Under the said programme, 21.3 square kilometers of land area remain to be de-mined as at 2026-01-01. Currently, the international NGOs such as Mines Advisory Group and The Halo Trust, as well as local NGOs such as Delvon Assistance for Social Harmony and Skavita Humanitarian Assistance and Relief Project are engaged in de-mining activities as local and international agencies in collaboration with the Sri Lanka Army Humanitarian De-mining Unit. The National Mine Action Centre enters into Memoranda of Understanding with the demining institutions annually in carrying out demining activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to sign 04 Memoranda of Understanding with the abovementioned institutions for the relevant work for the period from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the Host Country Agreement for establishing BIMSTEC Technology Transfer Facility in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - At the Second Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) Heads of States Summit held in New Delhi, India in the year 2008, a decision has been taken to establish a BIMSTEC Technology Transfer Facility in Sri Lanka through a Host Country Agreement made with the host country with the aim of enhancing regional cooperation. The Cooperation Agreement for this purpose was signed by the relevant Member States at the Fifth BIMSTEC Summit held in Colombo on 2022-03-30. The main objective of this Technology Transfer Facility includes providing technology, capacity building and intellectual property management for micro, small and medium enterprises in BIMSTEC member countries. According to the relevant Cooperation Agreement, an Agreement should be entered into between the host country, Sri Lanka, and the BIMSTEC Secretariat to formalize the legal status, privileges and immunities of the Technology Transfer Facility. The relevant institutional approvals and legal clearance have been obtained for the Agreement that has been drafted for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Science and Technology to sign the proposed Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Bilateral Memorandum of Understanding on Immigration Control Cooperation between the Department of Immigration and Emigration of Sri Lanka and the National Immigration Administration of the People’s Republic of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Immigration and Emigration of Sri Lanka and the National Immigration Administration of the People's Republic of China have reached a consensus for entering into a Memorandum of Understanding on Immigration Control Cooperation. The proposed Memorandum of Understanding is expected to achieve the objectives of facilitating discussions and visits conducted at the level of institutional heads and official representatives between the two countries, exchanging important official and intelligence information, facilitating visa, immigration and emigration matters affecting citizens engaged in business, investment, tourism, technological and scientific fields of both countries through an active and constructive approach, taking stringent measures against individuals involved in organized crimes such as human trafficking and smuggling and organizing workshops for the knowledge, skills and capacity development of officials. The clearance of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism and the Attorney General have been obtained for the proposed draft Agreement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to sign the said Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Treaty between the Republic of Korea and the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-12-11 to sign an Agreement between the Republic of Korea and the Government of Sri Lanka pertaining to granting mutual assistance in criminal matters. However, it has not been possible to sign the relevant Agreement between the two parties in accordance with the said approval. The said Agreement provides for mutual assistance by States to other States in matters such as handing over judicial documents and gathering evidence for use in criminal cases. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to sign the Agreement on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters between the Government of the Republic of Korea and the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the Complementary Adjustment Agreement pertaining to the Technical Cooperation Agreement signed between the Government of Brazil and the Government of Sri Lanka for implementation of the 'Sugarcane Project in Sri Lanka'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-31 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka entered into a Technical Cooperation Agreement with Brazil on 2008-09-16 for promoting bilateral cooperation in mutually beneficial sectors.  The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2026-05-25, granted approval to sign the Cooperation Agreement for implementation of a Project titled ‘Sugarcane Project in Sri Lanka’ between the Brazilian Cooperation Agency and the Federal University of São Carlos, the Ministry of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development of Sri Lanka and the Sugarcane Research Institute under the said Technical Cooperation Agreement. As per the Basic Agreement on Technical Cooperation signed between Sri Lanka and Brazil, it is required to implement the programmes and projects falling thereunder, through the Complementary Adjustment Agreements. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to sign the Complementary Adjustment Agreement pertaining to the implementation of the 'Sugarcane Project in Sri Lanka' between Brazil and Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting a Service Minute with regard to the establishment of a new Service category named ‘Specialist Medical and Specialist Dental Service’ in the Health Service of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-01-12 to appoint an Officials' Committee to submit recommendations with regard to the establishment of a Service category for Medical Specialists and Dental Specialists. The said Committee has submitted its Report after conducting an extensive review. Taking into account the recommendations of the said Report, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to establish a service category named Specialist Medical and Specialist Dental Service and to appoint an Officials' Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary, Ministry of Health and Mass Media to draft the service minute pertaining to the said service category, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Commissioner General of Motor Traffic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to appoint Air Vice Marshal (retired) Thushara Indunil Fernando to the currently vacant post of Commissioner General of Motor, on contract basis with immediate effect.

description: Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-01-20 to amend the relevant provision of the Civil Procedure Code, conferring powers on the Court to direct persons to give evidence through contemporaneous audio-visual linkage from a location at a remote point, upon a request made by a party or parties in a case pending before the Court, or a request made by its own motion, upon the agreement of parties through audio-visual linkage. Accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman.  The Proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations on the Beneficial Ownership under the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-07-21 to amend the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007 incorporating the legal requirements related to the registration of beneficial ownership of companies. Accordingly, the Companies (Amendment) Act, No.12 of 2025 has been passed by Parliament. The Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations, No.01 of 2026, made in terms of the provisions of the said Act, have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2480/48 and dated 2026-03-21. The proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to submit the said Regulations, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of the ‘Tourism for Heritage, Resilience, Inclusion and Value-driven Employment (THRIVE) - Nature’ Project for World Bank Financing
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although Sri Lanka possesses immense potential for nature-based tourism, it has been identified that the growth rate of income has been relatively low despite the gradual increase in tourist arrivals. The World Bank has expressed its willingness to provide a grant of US$ 1 million for a period of 18 months under the Grant Facility for Project Preparation (GFPP) for the arrangement of initial activities for a project called Tourism for Heritage Resilience Inclusion and Value-driven Employment (THRIVE) Nature for the improvement of habitats and development of infrastructure in nature-based tourism destinations. The proposed project will also support the further strengthening of programmes developed under the Ecosystem Conservation and Management Project implemented under the financial assistance of the World Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to accept the said grant and to prepare the proposed project using the said funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the proposed Smart Meters with Time-of-Use Billing System by Electricity Distribution Lanka (Private) Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-10-21 to obtain a loan of US$ 15 million through the Small Expenditure Financing facility of the Asian Development Bank to complementary projects that contribute to strengthening the country’s renewable energy efforts. At the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-09-03, approval has been granted to the use of US$ 2.5 million from the said loan to prepare the detailed design and tender documents for the Maha Oya Pumped Storage Hydropower Plant Development Project. The remaining US$ 12.5 million is proposed to be used to implement a project to install 300,000 Smart Meters with a Time-of-Use Billing System as part of Sri Lanka's Smart Grid Modernization initiative. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to implement the said project by Electricity Distribution Lanka (Private) Limited within a period of 02 years was, approved by the Cabinet of Ministers.
